summary: Ivanhoe Electric Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its intention to acquire a Crossover XRE Tunnel Boring Machine and material handling system from The Robbins Company for $64.7 million, for use at its Santa Cruz Copper Project in Arizona. The company secured a binding option in March 2026 and exercised it on May 8, 2026; final purchase is subject to definitive agreements expected by end of May 2026. This capital equipment acquisition is a routine operational procurement, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is involved. The filing replaces roadheader and grouting costs from the 2025 PFS with negligible net impact on project capital.
